themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying their advocacy for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants in public services, housing, and social benefits. This theme has seen strong convergence with similar legislative proposals and political rhetoric in multiple countries, reflecting a shared transnational strategy.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposed 'national priority' laws in Andalusia and other regions, restricting public housing and social aid to Spanish citizens.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Advocated for stricter immigration controls and prioritizing Italian citizens in social welfare programs.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Pushed for policies favoring Swedish citizens in welfare and housing, aligning with national priority rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposed measures to limit immigrant access to social benefits and public services.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Advocated for 'national preference' policies, restricting social benefits to French citizens.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Promoted policies to prioritize German citizens in welfare and housing, echoing national priority themes.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties have made significant gains in recent local elections across Europe, reflecting a broader trend of increasing support for right-wing and nationalist platforms. This theme has seen strong convergence, with parallel electoral successes and shared reactions from mainstream parties.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Gained ground in local elections, particularly in eastern Germany, with strong showings in mayoral races.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Secured victories in key municipal elections, consolidating power in northern and central Italy.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Made gains in regional elections, particularly in Andalusia and Castilla y León, often in coalition with the PP.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Increased its influence in local councils, particularly in southern Sweden, through coalition agreements.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions, often centered around leadership disputes, ideological differences, and strategic disagreements. This theme has seen strong convergence, with parallel conflicts emerging in multiple countries.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Faced internal conflicts over leadership and policy direction, particularly regarding judicial reforms and relations with the EU.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Experienced tensions between factions loyal to Viktor Orbán and those supporting Péter Magyar, leading to public disputes.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Struggled with internal divisions over leadership and policy direction, particularly regarding immigration and Brexit.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Faced internal debates over leadership and strategy, particularly regarding alliances with other right-wing parties.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Grappling with internal conflicts between factions loyal to Javier Milei and those advocating for a more moderate approach.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
